content: Ketsutsi Natsareti kiekariyaritsie kemɨtiuyeikakai
Merikɨtsɨ mana kaneyani, yukiekaritsie kaninuani, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaneweiyakaitɨni.

Hikɨ 'uxipiya tukari 'aye'aku, tukita kanitsutɨani ti'ɨkitatɨ. Mɨkɨ memi'eniekai meyumɨiretɨ mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —¿'Ikɨ meixeiya, hakewa pemieme? ¿'Ikɨ ketiupitɨarie mɨtimaiwenikɨ? ¿Ketiupitɨarie 'inɨari mɨtɨrɨkawi mɨtiyurienekɨ?
¿'Ikɨ kɨyekɨ mɨreutawewiwe katihɨkɨ, Mariya nu'aya, Kakuwu, Kutse, Kura, Tsimuni wa'iwa katihɨkɨ? ¿'Ena tahetsɨa mekatetitei 'iwamama 'ukari? Hikɨ mekanitixani'erieni.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kakaɨyari niukameya naitsarie 'aixɨa pɨtixeiyarie, peru yukwiepa, yumarema watsata meta yukiita 'aixɨa pɨkatixeiyarie.
Mana pɨkayɨwekai xeime mariwemekɨ mɨtiyurienikɨ, hipame tekwikwikate xeikɨa yuxexuime wahetsie 'utimeka 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame kaniwarayeitɨani.
Yuri memɨkate'eriekaikɨ, kani'iyarixiekaitɨni. Hikɨ kiekarite 'etsimɨyeyeutsie katiniku'ɨkitanekaitɨni.
Tamamata heimana huta kemɨtiwareutanɨ'axɨa
Merikɨtsɨ tamamata heimana huta warukuxeɨrieka, hikɨ kaniwareutanɨ'axɨani yuhutatame, heitserie warupitɨaka kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene wahepaɨtsita.
Meta kaniwaruta'imaiya tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehepinenikɨ huyeta timieme, 'inɨa pɨkatixaɨ, kɨtsiuri pɨkatixaɨ, tumini pɨkatixaɨ 'imanameta yemaneme, matsi xeikɨa 'itsɨ.
Yukakaitsie xeikɨa memeu'uixɨanikɨ, peru huta kamixayari memɨka'anakatɨkɨnikɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani.
Mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe: «Hakewa xeme'axɨani kiita, muwa xekeneyuhayewani 'atsita kepaukake xemɨyehu.

Xɨka, xaɨtsie 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ xekahetanaki'eriwa, yatɨni xɨka mekayuwaɨriyani memɨxe'enienikɨ, mana xe'ayekɨneme, tumuanari xekeneukatsixɨa yu'ɨkatetsie, mɨpaɨ xeteyurietɨ xemɨtewatahekɨatɨanikɨ wahetsie kemɨrahɨiwani».
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaneutayeixɨani, mɨpaɨ metekuxatatɨ, teɨteri memɨtehayewakɨ 'axakememɨteyuriekɨ.
Yaxeikɨata yuwaɨkawa kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwanɨkai mekaniwarayenɨ'axɨani, meta tekwikwikate yuwaɨkawa 'aixɨa mekateniwaruka'eritɨani, hatseiti mewarukawiriwatɨ.
Ti'ɨyame Wani kemɨtiumierie

Hikɨ Herurexi mɨti'aitametɨkai mana kwiepa kaniu'ena. Naitsarie kaniutamariwa Ketsutsi kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨtɨkai. Mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Wani Ti'ɨyame kaniyɨaneni, 'umɨka panukuke, 'ayumieme tɨrɨkariya kanexeiyani mariwemekɨ mɨtiyurienenikɨ».
Hipatɨta mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekatɨni: «'Eriyaxi kanihɨkɨtɨni». Hipatɨta mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Kakaɨyari niukameya kaniyɨaneni meripai miemete».
Herurexi matsi 'u'enaka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Wani kanihɨkɨtɨni nemita'aitaxɨ mu'uya manutiwitekienikɨ, mɨkɨ kananukuketɨarieni».

Mɨkɨ Herurexi meripaitɨ kaniwarutanɨ'akaitɨni Wani memɨwiyakɨ, katsariyanata kanenutahɨani. Mɨpaɨ Heruriya mɨtinakekaikɨ, mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni Herurexi mitiwitɨkɨ yu'iwa 'ɨyaya, Heruriya mɨtitewakai, Peripe 'ɨyaya.
Wani kawiyariewetɨ 'akuxi Herurexi mɨpaɨ katinikɨhɨawekaitɨni: «Pepɨkapitɨarie pemewitɨkɨnikɨ 'a'iwa 'ɨyaya».
Heruriya kani'uxiwe'eriekaitɨni, pɨtikuwaunekai Wani kehapaɨ mɨtimienikɨ.

Herurexi Wani kanimakarɨkaitɨni, 'imaitɨ tewi heitseriemekɨ yamɨtikamie mɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ, mɨpatsiekaikɨ Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme, kani'ɨwiyakaitɨni. 'I'enietɨ 'atsipɨkatimaikai keri mɨtiyurienikeyu, peru kaninakekaitɨni mi'eniekakɨ.
Merikɨtsɨ tukari kanaye'ani Heruriya Wani ma'iwakɨ, kepauka Herurexi 'ixɨarari muwewi matinuiwaxɨ tukariyaritsie. Te'aitamete, kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete, Karereyatari wa'ukiyarima kaniwaruta'inieni.

Heruriya niweya 'uka heutahaka katiniutineini, hikɨ Herurexi kaninakire meta hamatɨana memɨtekwakai yunaitɨ. Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ 'ɨimari katiniutahɨawe: —Tita mɨmatinake kenetineutawawiri, ne nepɨmatsimini.
Hikɨ yurikɨ kaniyɨhɨritɨani mɨpaɨ rehɨawetɨ: —Tita pemɨnetitawawirieni nepɨmatsimini, tsepa kwiepa nemɨra'aita hixɨata 'arɨkame pemɨnetiutawawiri.
Mɨkɨ 'ɨimari kaneyani mɨpaɨ yumaama katiniuta'iwawiya: —¿Ketita netitawawirieni? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Wani Ti'ɨyame mu'uya keneutawawiri.
Mexɨima heutahaka ti'aitame hetsɨa, kanitawawirieni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Ipaɨ kanetininakeni ne, hikɨ kwitɨwa pepɨnetsiyetuirieni Wani Ti'ɨyame mu'uya, xakɨtsie yekaime.
Hikɨ ti'aitame waɨkawa kaniyukahiwerieni, peru mɨyɨhɨritɨakaikɨ teɨteri hamatɨana memɨtekwakai wahɨxie, 'ayumieme pɨkayuwaɨriyakai mita'imaiyakɨ.
Ti'aitame kuya kaniutanɨ'ani kwitɨwa, Wani mu'uya kaniuta'aita mi'atɨirienikɨ.
Mɨkɨ heyaka, mu'uya kananutiwiteni katsariyanata. Xakɨtsie yekaime kani'atɨirieni, 'ɨimari kaniyetuirieni, meta 'ɨimari yumaama kaniyetuirieni.
Hikɨ mete'utamarieka, Wani teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mekanekɨne, kaxarieya mekanekweni, teukiyapa mekaneitateni.
Teɨteri kemɨtiwarumi 'auxɨwime miriyari
Merikɨtsɨ nɨ'ariekate Ketsutsi hetsɨa mekaniyukuxeɨrieni, kememɨte'uyuri kememɨte'ɨkitakai mete'itaxatɨanike.
'Iya mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kɨmɨtsɨ taxaɨta tepuhu makumawetsie, mana temeka'uxipienikɨ. Hipatɨ yuwaɨkawatɨ mekani'axekaitɨni meta mekanekɨkakaitɨni, 'ayumieme tukari mepɨkahɨkai memɨtekwanikɨ.
Hikɨ kanuwatsie mekanekɨne makumawetsie paitɨ meyuxaɨtame.
Peru yuwaɨkawatɨ mekaniwaruxeiya mekaniwaretimani memayekɨtsie. Naitsarie kiekaritsie kiekatari yuwaɨkawatɨ yɨ'ɨkama mekanekɨne me'unautsaxɨaximetɨ, me'anuyehaitɨtɨatɨ mekaneta'axɨani mɨkɨ meri.

Hikɨ kepauka Ketsutsi manatitɨa kanuwatsie, teɨteri kaniwaruxeiya yumɨireme, hikɨ kaniwarutinenimayata, muxatsi yɨhɨweme memɨkahexeiya wahepaɨ memɨ'anenekaikɨ. Mana kanitsutɨani tiwa'ɨkitɨatɨ waɨkawamekɨ.
Hikɨ tau 'akayunirɨmekaku, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama hetsɨana mekaniyukuxeɨrieni mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —'Ena kanakumaweni, tau kanakayunirɨmeniri.
Keniwarutateutɨari teɨteri 'ahurawa memɨtayeixɨanikɨ kiekarite 'etsimɨyeyeutsie meta 'emɨyeyeutsie, 'ikwai memɨteyutinanairienikɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xeme pɨta xeketeniwarumikwa. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —¿Tame tete'inanaiyu paa huta tsienituyari hetsie 'akame, temɨtewaminikɨ?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Kepaɨmeme paa xepexeiya? Xekeneuti'iwau. Yametehetimaika, mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Paa 'auxɨwime meta tsapari yuhutame.
Hikɨ kaniwaruta'aitɨani yunaitɨ memukuyaxixɨanikɨ 'ɨxapa makutsiurauyetsie.
Merikɨte mekaneukuyaxixɨani xeitsienituyari meta huta tewiyari heimana tamamata meyupapaɨmetɨ.

Hikɨ paa 'auxɨwime 'anu'ɨka meta tsapari yuhutame, taheima heutinieretɨ pamɨpariyutsi Kakaɨyari kaniupitɨani. Hikɨ paa 'utitaraka kaniwaru'ɨitɨani teyu'ɨkitɨwamete mɨkɨta teɨteri memɨwaminikɨ. Meta tsapari memɨyuhuta kaniwarutimura yunaime wahetsiemieme.
Yunaitɨ mekateniukwani mekaniutihuxani,
hikɨ teyu'ɨkitɨwamete mekanikuxeɨrieni paa muyuhayewaxɨ tamamata heimana huta tsikɨiwitiyari hɨpɨneme, meta tsapari memuyuhayewaxɨ.
Mɨkɨ memɨte'ukwai 'ukitsi 'auxɨwime miriyari mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni.
Ketsutsi haa heima kemɨtiuyeikakai
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete kaniwarutamexɨitɨani kanuwatsie memɨkayaxekɨ mɨkɨ meri memɨyehukɨ 'anutaɨye Wetsaira paitɨ, mexi mɨkɨ teɨteri wateutɨanekai.
Warutateutɨaka, hɨritsie kanitiyune heyutanenewienike.
Hikɨ 'ukuyɨreku, kanuwa harakuna hixɨapa kaniuyewiekaitɨni, peru Ketsutsi kwiepa 'akuxi kaniuyeikakaitɨni yuxaɨta.

Ximeri 'etsiwatɨkaku kahekɨarirɨmekaku, me'uximatɨariekame kaniwaruxeiya waɨriyarika kanuwa me'uwekirɨmeme, wahepa maye'ekakaikɨ. Ketsutsi wahepa kaniuyani harakuna heima 'umietɨ, wa'aurie kaniuyeyanikekaitɨni.
Mɨkɨ me'ixeiyaka haa heima 'amiekame, mɨki me'erietɨ mekaniutihiwa,
waɨkawa memamatɨ mɨyamemɨtenenierekaikɨ. Peru mɨkɨ kaniwarutahɨawe, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kayuwatɨ xeketeneuyaxi. Ne nepɨyɨane. Xepɨkamamaka».
Hikɨ wahamatɨa kanuwatsie kayerɨku, 'eka kaneunuani. Mɨkɨ yemekɨ kwinimieme mekatenihɨxiyakaitɨni,
paa hepaɨtsita kemɨtiuyɨ 'atsimepɨkatehetimaiwawekai, matsi yu'iyaritsie mepɨweraranikai.
Hikɨ 'anutaɨye me'anukɨneka Kenetsareti kwieyaritsie mekaniye'axɨani. Mana mekanekuwieni kanuwa.
Kanuwatsie me'anatikɨneku, yapauka kiekatari Ketsutsi mekanetimani.
Naitsarie mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie mekaneutayeixɨani, hikɨ mekanitsutɨani tekwikwikate mewa'atɨwatɨ 'itaritsie me'aheitɨkaime me'imarietɨ hakewa meyeikakai.

Naitsarie kemɨtikuyeikakai, kiekarite 'etsimɨyeyeutsie, 'emɨyeyeutsie, yeuta, tekwikwikate kiekari hixɨapa mekanikutuariwakaitɨni, waɨriyarika me'ipitɨatɨ tsikere 'ixurikieya tetsimeyaritsie memimayɨanikɨ, yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane memimayɨa 'aixɨa meteheu'erietɨ mepakɨkakai.
